title: kbingest map leaves the MSBuild NuGet SDK resolver able to fetch an SDK
goal: NETWORK_OFF sets MSBUILDDISABLENUGETSDKRESOLVER=1 (after confirming the variable in Microsoft docs and adding the fact to agents/codebase-mapping.md with a DOC source row), so an Sdk=\"X/1.0\" reference, a global.json msbuild-sdks entry or a repository NuGet.Config proxy cannot make evaluation download and import an SDK package; a missing SDK is a note; a test named kbingest_map_dotnet_no_sdk_resolver asserts the variable reaches dotnet (sprint SP-fkyrld5h review finding F5, inferred, not reproduced)
